acceptance.command: Source receipt, attribution notice, and pinned-reference static checks
acceptance.proof: The exact upstream commit and blobs are recorded, the creator permission relayed by the project owner is bound to AGPL-3.0-or-later, and copied or translated work retains attribution.

acceptance.command: VR Strobe route and safety-state JVM tests
acceptance.proof: The feature remains disabled by default; restored state and presets cannot start output; an explicit warning acknowledgement plus current-run begin gesture is required; duration, focus loss, pause, stop, and activity destruction return the carrier to black and release it.

acceptance.command: Preset/profile catalog JVM and static parity checks
acceptance.proof: The five simulation presets, four real-strobe presets, two designer routes, and their source parameter payloads are represented without medical/device-equivalence claims.

acceptance.command: Interference profile codec, parameter-boundary, and shader contract tests
acceptance.proof: Colors, oscillator, global transform, up to eight stripes/ripples/rays/Perlin fields, trail, blur, glow, brightness, contrast, noise, and vignette controls have one validated profile representation and Spatial render mapping.

acceptance.command: Real-strobe profile, phase, noise, fixation, and duration tests
acceptance.proof: Colors, frequency, duty, phase noise, fixation, pause, bounded duration, and completion behavior match the pinned source semantics while remaining inert until the explicit safety gate passes.

acceptance.command: Focused JVM tests, Spatial static checks, and shader compilation
acceptance.proof: Host evidence passes without ADB mutation, APK installation, headset launch, or claims about temporal display fidelity.

commit_policy: Keep the permission receipt, app-local port, host validation, and attribution in one reviewable local source slice. Do not publish or run temporal headset content without a later explicitly authorized device unit.

instruction_surfaces.change_reason: Confirm the port remains an app-local, explicit-opt-in Spatial SDK surface and does not change the native Quest default.
Document provenance, parity surface, authority, safety behavior, controls, evidence markers, and later attended validation.
Retain upstream creator attribution and the pinned source identity beside the port.
Apply the existing Quest app-local and permission-cleared reference-intake boundary without changing the router.
Apply existing authority, profile, observability, lifecycle, and validation rules without changing the skill.
Keep the source unit device-forbidden and reserve temporal headset work for an explicit attended follow-up.

non_scope: Launching flashing, oscillating, or otherwise temporal stimulus content on a headset in this unit.
Autostarting a stimulus from a preset, property, intent, restored UI state, or application launch.
Claiming treatment, entrainment, altered-state, Lucia, Roxiva, or other medical efficacy or device equivalence.
Treating the upstream WebXR frame loop as Quest timing, lifecycle, safety, or presentation authority.
Claiming compositor scanout timing, temporal frequency fidelity, stereo comfort, or device performance from host evidence.
Changing the accepted MOD-007 camera remediation or its pending attended validation.
objective: Port the permission-cleared vr_strobe portal, preset catalog, interference designer, and real-strobe designer into the Meta Spatial SDK application as an app-local, default-disabled native Quest surface with explicit safety gating and no temporal headset launch in this source unit.
outputs: Pinned source-permission and attribution record for vr_strobe commit 52c71cc069f4102bc4148e05c5fd3fc4d5466479.
App-local preset/profile model covering the portal, real-strobe controls, and interference pattern controls.
Spatial Compose portal/designer panel with explicit warning, acknowledgement, preview, begin, pause, stop, completion, and return routes.
Spatial custom-fragment carrier for real-strobe and interference modes with bounded lifecycle cleanup and effective markers.
Host tests, shader/static validation, and implementation documentation with a later attended-device protocol.

validation.command: VR Strobe focused JVM tests and static gate
Spatial Camera Panel JVM suite, workflow/static regression gates, and shader compilation
